title: Fourier Analysis

syllabus.details: Fourier transform of functions over T, the unit disk.Fourier series.
The classical kernels. Fejer’s, Poisson’s and Dirichlet’s summability kernels.
The convergence of Fourier series in norm and point wise.
Fourier series of square summable functions.
Fourier transform of functions on R and their properties.
Space of rapidly decreasing functions & their properties.
Poisson summation formula, Heisenberg uncertainty Principle,Wiener’s Tauberian theorem.
Kronecker’s theorem, isoperimetric inequality as applications.
